item.title: How recruitment fraud turned cloud IAM into a $2 billion attack surface
item.description: A developer gets a LinkedIn message from a recruiter. The role looks legitimate. The coding assessment requires installing a package. That package exfiltrates all cloud credentials from the developer’s machine — GitHub personal access tokens, AWS API keys, Azure service principals and more — are exfiltrated, and the adversary is inside the cloud environment within minutes.Your email security never saw it. item.title: What AI builders can learn from fraud models that run in 300 milliseconds
item.description: Fraud protection is a race against scale.
